description: The Infra-Red Atmospheric Sounder (IRAS) on FY-3C is a 26-channel infrared sounder measuring atmospheric radiation across carbon dioxide, ozone, water vapor, and window bands. Its filters enable vertical profiling of atmospheric temperature, moisture, and cloud properties.
facility_description: FengYun-3C is the third satellite in China’s second-generation polar-orbiting meteorological series (morning sun-synchronous orbit), launched in September 2013 and operated by the National Satellite Meteorological Center (NSMC) of the China Meteorological Administration (CMA).
notes: FY-3C IRAS filter profiles originate from the NSMC GSICS calibration portal (http://gsics.nsmc.org.cn/portal/en/fycv/srf.html). Portal footer asserts Copyright © NSMC(NCSW). All Rights Reserved., with redistribution terms governed by CMA data policy. DetectorType is left unchanged.
